question: Two numbers are respectively 47% and 25% more than a third number. The ratio of the two numbers is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **third number** be 100.

**First number** = 100 + 47% of 100 = 147

**Second number** = 100 + 25% of 100 = 125

**Required ratio** = 147 : 125

**∴ The correct answer is 147 : 125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the **third number** be **x**.

**First number** (N₁) = x + 47% of x

**Second number** (N₂) = x + 25% of x

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46cc6a02d6a8a400f212a0f37e61a7083e2f0121f5f06c6aeac782f04ec64a8e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ N₁ = x + 0.47x = 1.47x

⇒ N₂ = x + 0.25x = 1.25x

⇒ Ratio = N₁ : N₂

⇒ Ratio = 1.47x : 1.25x

⇒ Ratio = 147 : 125

**∴ The correct answer is 147 : 125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

When a value increases by r%, the new value is Base × (1 + r/100).

Ratio Comparison

A ratio a : b can be expressed as a fraction a/b. To simplify, multiply both terms by the same number to remove decimals.

Base Selection

In comparison questions, always assume the common reference point (third number) as 100 for easier calculation.</p
